label: Ember Field
author: Conky-Studio
description: Rising ember particles in a box. Trigger increases density and speed — great ambient heat/CPU chrome.
lua_draw_body:
local x, y, w, h = {x}, {y}, {width}, {height}
 local n = math.floor({count} + 0.5)
 local energy = math.min(math.max((tonumber({trigger}) or 0) / 100, 0), 1)
 local speed = {speed} * (0.5 + energy)
 local t = wall_clock()
 local r, g, b = {color}
 local active = math.max(3, math.floor(n * (0.35 + 0.65 * energy)))
 for i = 1, active do
  local seed = i * 19.17
  local px = x + (w * ((math.sin(seed * 1.3) * 0.5 + 0.5)))
  local rise = (t * speed * (0.7 + 0.5 * ((i % 5) / 5)) + seed * 13) % (h + 10)
  local py = y + h - rise
  local fade = 1 - (rise / (h + 10))
  local flicker = 0.6 + 0.4 * math.sin(t * 6 + seed)
  local sz = {size} * (0.6 + 0.6 * fade) * (0.7 + 0.3 * energy)
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity} * fade * fade * flicker)
  cairo_arc(cr, px, py, sz, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_fill(cr)
 end
